+"""Standalone copy of Click's subcommand completion lookup.
+
+This module has no dependency on ``click`` so it can be imported by file
+path without loading the package.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import typing as t
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_visible_commands", "vendored_visible_commands_variant"]
+
+
+class Command(t.Protocol):
+    hidden: bool
+
+
+class Context(t.Protocol):
+    command: t.Any
+
+
+class Group(Command, t.Protocol):
+    def list_commands(self, ctx: Context) -> list[str]: ...
+
+    def get_command(self, ctx: Context, cmd_name: str) -> Command | None: ...
+
+
+def vendored_visible_commands(
+    ctx: Context, incomplete: str
+) -> cabc.Iterator[tuple[str, Command]]:
+    """List all the subcommands of a group that start with the
+    incomplete value and aren't hidden.
+
+    :param ctx: Invocation context for the group.
+    :param incomplete: Value being completed. May be empty.
+    """
+    multi = t.cast(Group, ctx.command)
+
+    for name in multi.list_commands(ctx):
+        if name.startswith(incomplete):
+            command = multi.get_command(ctx, name)
+
+            if command is not None and not command.hidden:
+                yield name, command
+
+
+def vendored_visible_commands_variant(
+    ctx: Context, incomplete: str
+) -> cabc.Iterator[tuple[str, Command]]:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_visible_commands`, but yield the pairs sorted
+    by name instead of in discovery order.
+    """
+    yield from sorted(
+        vendored_visible_commands(ctx, incomplete), key=lambda item: item[0]
+    )

+import importlib.util
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src" / "standalone_wave6_visible_commands.py"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def mod():
+    before = {name for name in sys.modules if name.split(".")[0] == "click"}
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_visible_commands", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    after = {name for name in sys.modules if name.split(".")[0] == "click"}
+    assert after == before
+    return module
+
+
+class FakeGroup:
+    def __init__(self, commands, order=None):
+        self.commands = commands
+        self.order = order if order is not None else list(commands)
+        self.calls = []
+
+    def list_commands(self, ctx):
+        return list(self.order)
+
+    def get_command(self, ctx, name):
+        self.calls.append(name)
+        return self.commands.get(name)
+
+
+def cmd(hidden=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(hidden=hidden)
+
+
+def make_ctx(group):
+    return SimpleNamespace(command=group)
+
+
+def test_exports(mod):
+    assert set(mod.__all__) == {
+        "vendored_visible_commands",
+        "vendored_visible_commands_variant",
+    }
+
+
+def test_vendored_filters_prefix_hidden_and_missing(mod):
+    b, a, hidden = cmd(), cmd(), cmd(hidden=True)
+    group = FakeGroup(
+        {"beta": b, "alpha": a, "aux": hidden, "gamma": cmd()},
+        order=["beta", "alpha", "aux", "ghost", "gamma"],
+    )
+    ctx = make_ctx(group)
+    assert list(mod.vendored_visible_commands(ctx, "")) == [
+        ("beta", b),
+        ("alpha", a),
+        ("gamma", group.commands["gamma"]),
+    ]
+    assert list(mod.vendored_visible_commands(ctx, "a")) == [("alpha", a)]
+    assert "beta" not in group.calls[-2:]
+
+
+def test_vendored_is_lazy(mod):
+    group = FakeGroup({"x": cmd()})
+    gen = mod.vendored_visible_commands(make_ctx(group), "")
+    assert group.calls == []
+    next(gen)
+    assert group.calls == ["x"]
+
+
+def test_vendored_empty(mod):
+    assert list(mod.vendored_visible_commands(make_ctx(FakeGroup({})), "")) == []
+    group = FakeGroup({"a": cmd()})
+    assert list(mod.vendored_visible_commands(make_ctx(group), "z")) == []
+
+
+def test_vendored_error_propagates(mod):
+    class Broken(FakeGroup):
+        def get_command(self, ctx, name):
+            raise RuntimeError("boom")
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
+        list(mod.vendored_visible_commands(make_ctx(Broken({"a": cmd()})), ""))
+
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        list(mod.vendored_visible_commands(make_ctx(object()), ""))
+
+
+def test_variant_sorts_by_name(mod):
+    c, a, b = cmd(), cmd(), cmd()
+    group = FakeGroup(
+        {"c": c, "a": a, "b": b, "ab": cmd(hidden=True)},
+        order=["c", "ab", "a", "b"],
+    )
+    ctx = make_ctx(group)
+    assert list(mod.vendored_visible_commands_variant(ctx, "")) == [
+        ("a", a),
+        ("b", b),
+        ("c", c),
+    ]
+    assert list(mod.vendored_visible_commands_variant(ctx, "a")) == [("a", a)]
+
+
+def test_variant_empty(mod):
+    assert (
+        list(mod.vendored_visible_commands_variant(make_ctx(FakeGroup({})), "")) == []
+    )
+
+
+def test_variant_error_propagates(mod):
+    class Broken(FakeGroup):
+        def list_commands(self, ctx):
+            raise ValueError("bad")
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="bad"):
+        list(mod.vendored_visible_commands_variant(make_ctx(Broken({})), ""))
